audit_plan: Independent coefficient and ledger replay plus paired EUR-to-USD invariance checks. This revision does not add a new scientific claim.
intended_claims: C1: Pairwise carbon benefit does not determine allocation when complete-service budgets and resource opportunity costs bind. Seek explicit matched counterexample, no universal ranking.
C2: Changing the conventional supply inventory at fixed physical/pricing/access conditions can change the allocation frontier. Identify the specific tested regions and domains.
C3: Payment object, eligibility and benefit pass-through can change private allocation in controlled cases. Do not attribute cross-region output differences entirely to policy.

C4: Yulin can supply conditional mechanism evidence if source/hydrogen anchors and bounded unknown inputs support the declared result scope. Stable point ranking requires separate invariance; otherwise show boundaries rather than actual project optimum.
stop_rule: Stop after modeling report. Discuss manuscript content with user before editing body or SI.
